uncited: **Sampling:** Sample points $x_i$ along the ray within the axis-aligned bounding box ($x_{AABB}$).
The number of samples is determined by `step_size` and `min_samples_per_ray`.
**LOS Integration:** Perform the Line-of-Sight integral of $c_{\text{coef}}$ along the ray to obtain the final intensity.
This is computed as $I = \sum_{i} c_{\text{coef}}(i) \cdot \Delta s_i$, where $\Delta s_i$ is the step size.
